caption:
Your revenue is not one number.

It's three: leads, close rate, and average job value, multiplied together.

Most owners only pull the first lever. They spend more on ads to get more leads, then wonder why revenue barely moves.

Run this audit on your own shop this week:
1. Count last month's leads.
2. Divide jobs won by leads to get your close rate.
3. Pull your average ticket from the last 10 jobs.

A 10% lift in one number moves revenue. A 10% lift in all three compounds past 10%, because they multiply, not add.

See your own three numbers laid out for you.
